notes: Coders agreed on both document stances (delegates) and on most matched units. Main disagreements: (1) phase and actor on staff and faculty duties (general vs a stage; resolved to general for non-course staff duties, ta-staff for the Work list); (2) policy_type where a unit fits two types (P98/P103, P09/P36, P31/P62, P102/P63, P92/P51, P76/P103/P100), resolved by the type whose definition matches the sentence's own rule, with the other noted in a fit_note; (3) unit_stance on disclosure/enforcement/training units (permit vs neutral vs encourage), resolved to permit for conditions on permitted use, restrict where a sentence narrows a permission, neutral for rationale, sanctions and training; (4) splitting: sentences holding two rules were split into two units. Auto-alignment mis-paired two units (u1 A3/B3, the recommended hybrid vs option 2; u2 A82/B98, two items of one FAQ sentence) and missed one (A46/B48); corrected by hand. Units found by one coder were checked against the text; 37 kept (14 from A, 23 from B), 7 dropped (u1 options 1 and 2 that are not adopted policy, and 5 exact or near repeats of sample statements).
